digest.component_or_area: rebar reconciler — typed outbound mutation payloads and legacy compatibility removal
propositions: Exact-patchset CI workflow must verify and record the Gerrit patchset SHA; an all-skipped or wrong-ref run fails AC1/AC2 requirements.
Legacy and typed reconciler behavior must match on normalized plans, outcomes, and state across the comprehensive mutation matrix without writing the same issue twice.

Production outbound producer must emit only typed Mutation objects with typed OutboundCreatePayload/OutboundUpdatePayload/OutboundDeletePayload payloads; raw-dict Mutation.payload construction paths are eliminated.

The dual-call-shape applier.apply() API (typed Mutation vs. list of pre-built dict entries) must remain as documented and extensively-tested public compatibility, distinct from production-path ambiguity elimination.
Portable shadow corpus regression oracle and live-DC exact-patchset lane must both pass; portable remains authoritative when Docker/DC is unavailable.
Typed-only post-cutover DC convergence must complete twice without duplicate effects, lost fields, cross-project contamination, or unexplained diagnostics.
